threshold_freeze_requirements: Thresholds must be frozen before any classifier model prediction is generated.
Thresholds must use the already frozen metrics from classifier design v2 and contract test pack v3.
The primary metric remains four-field exact-match accuracy.
Secondary gates must protect source-domain accuracy, source-class macro recall, unresolved recall, resolved recall, contrast-group consistency, and malformed/error rate.
Per-class recall must be reported even if not every class receives an independent hard threshold.
No threshold may be changed after the first model prediction without retiring that prediction set as development data.
Freezing thresholds does not itself authorise classifier implementation or candidate v7.
